gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.status.en: Projects one block of rock layer every %s s
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.status.zh: 每 %s 秒投影一格岩层

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.status.en: The End and most other dimensions have no ley lines
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.status.zh: 末地和别的维度没有地脉

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.status.en: Your earlier projector at (%s, %s, %s) already uses this chunk's ley line; this one waits
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.status.zh: 你在（%s, %s, %s）更早放下的投影仪已经占用了这个区块的地脉，这台先等着

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.status.en: Break that one, or move this one to another chunk
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.status.zh: 拆掉那台，或者把这台搬到别的区块

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.status.en: Take items out of the output slots and it resumes by itself
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.status.zh: 取走输出格里的东西，它会自己接着投影

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.status.en: Nobody placed this projector by hand, so it won't work. Break it and place it again yourself
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.status.zh: 这台投影仪不是玩家亲手放下的，不会工作；拆下来自己重新放一次

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.keep_r.en: When on, blocks that hold no ore give rock (cobblestone, cobbled deepslate…) instead of nothing
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.keep_r.zh: 打开后，没出矿的格子会出岩石（圆石、深板岩圆石……），关着时这些格子什么都不出

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.keep_r.en: Each kind of rock takes one output slot, 2 slots at most; rock that does not fit is thrown away and never blocks ore
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.keep_r.zh: 每种岩石只占一个输出格、岩石合计最多 2 格，放不下的直接丢掉，不会挡住矿

gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.lens_e.en: Lens: put one Pale Gem here; projected ores then drop as with Fortune I
gui.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.lens_e.zh: 透镜：放 1 颗淡青宝石，投影出的矿按时运 I 掉落

tooltip.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.en: Uses MRU to project ores from the rock layers below. Never touches blocks in the world
tooltip.essentialcraft5.ley_projector.zh: 用 MRU 投影出脚下岩层里的矿，世界里的方块一格不动

tooltip.essentialcraft5.pale_gem.lens.en: In a Ley Projector's lens slot: projected ores drop as with Fortune I
tooltip.essentialcraft5.pale_gem.lens.zh: 放进地脉投影仪的透镜格：投影出的矿按时运 I 掉落
